name: llds
description: LL Dance Studio – app for dancers, parents and trainers (React + Capacitor + Supabase).

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.smoke: node smoke.mjs && node smoke2.mjs && node smoke3.mjs && node smoke4.mjs && node smoke5.mjs && node smoke6.mjs && node smoke7.mjs
scripts.site: python3 scripts/site-gen.py ../ilumie-site/llds && npm run build:web && rm -rf ../ilumie-site/llds/app && cp -r dist ../ilumie-site/llds/app
